QuestInfo.name: The Seed That Swallow Lost
QuestInfo.0: I lost the seed that Swallow gave. I better go visit again.
QuestInfo.1: I lost the seed that Swallow gave, so I had to explain the circumstances to it. After some deliberation, it decided to look for another seed, and asked me to wait for a bit, then talk to it again.
QuestInfo.2: I went to see Swallow because I have lost the seed myself, and it gave me a new one. Now, who should I give this to?

0.0: What's going on? What? You lost the seed?? How can you lose it? Okay, I'll give you another one right now. This time, PLEASE don't lose it, and give it to the rightful owner, okay?

yes.0: I need to look for it, so please talk to me in a little bit.

no.0: Well, then you won't need the seed. Good bye.

1.0: Please get this to the rightful owner, although I still have no idea who should receive this.
